title: Chains under a cap on places
claim: Theorem 1: in the proved class, with every knot live and at most five places, every piece of the relayed map carries at most two rays, a relay included (Lemma 1: no 3-, 4-, 6-cycles, groups are candidate pairs; Lemma 2: the non-leaves form one path or one cycle). Corollary 2: such tree starts close or grow in one or two dimensions; cycle cores carry no rays. Theorem 3: at six places with every knot live, and at five places with dead knots, there are tree starts in the class with any number of rays in one piece.
standard_statement: Caterpillars (Harary and Schwenk 1973); the identification line's theorems.
prior_work: DOUBLE-IDENT-20261119-001 (multigraphs, dead knots as blocks), RELAY-IDENT-20261119-001 (relays, tree dimension), WEIGHTINGS-20261119-001 (the bare-tree caterpillar lemma, post hoc).
completion_gate: machine_check.py: C1-C8 of proof.md; the referee reviews the proof.
